mode: READ_ONLY_PASSIVE: catalog + existing rows; SELECT statements only; no writes, no probes, no rolled-back inserts
snapshot_rule: every query restricts to rows with created_at (or start_time for cron) < snapshot_cutoff_utc

miners.M0_profile: distinct and null counts per non-excluded column
miners.M1_functional_dependency: for each pair of categorical columns (2..40 distinct values): A -> B holds when every A value maps to one B value
miners.M2_inclusion_cardinality: for shared keys between tables: coverage both ways and multiplicity (1:1, 1:n, partial)
miners.M3_lifecycle: event-type transitions within each run, ordered by sequence; terminal types
miners.M4_timing_threshold: per cron job: status by duration; a single duration cut separating statuses is a MAGNITUDE_RELATION candidate
miners.M5_numeric_relations: within-row numeric invariants (<=, equality) and ratio formulas among numeric columns; status vs a numeric cut

settlement_rule.functional_dependency: zero violating rows, at least 2 groups and 30 rows, AND an independent verifier query (self-join NOT EXISTS formulation) finds zero counterexamples
settlement_rule.inclusion: anti-join counts recomputed by the verifier formulation
settlement_rule.near_rules: rules with violations are reported with counts and never settled
settlement_rule.silence: absence of a rule is UNRESOLVED, never settled as independence

privacy: results stored in Density UAP contain column names, category counts, rule statements and hashes only; no free text, no uuids, no row copies
anchors: the user confirms or rejects a sample of learned rules after the run; those confirmations become the first real anchors
